name: PMO Management Reviews
query:
SELECT
    name AS "Review:Link/PMO Management Review:220",
    review_title AS "Review Title:Data:260",
    review_date AS "Review Date:Date:120",
    chair AS "Chair:Link/User:180",
    period AS "Period:Data:120",
    status AS "Status:Data:140"
FROM `tabPMO Management Review`
ORDER BY review_date DESC, review_title
